- [Value to Merchants](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/network-tokens/value-to-merchants/)

- [Getting Started with Network Tokens](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/network-tokens/getting-started): Network Tokens are available for merchants in the United States and select regions in North America, South America, and Europe who are processing full stack with Braintree.
